title: ArcadiaPack
description: A pack made for the lovely gremlins of Arcadia
body:
## Hi Arcadia! This is the pack for and by you!

This pack features custom textures for various entities and items. Some of these additions will require the CIT and CEM features of optifine. However, you can use [CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn/) and [Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features/) instead if you're using fabric :)

![Muggins Golem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97fad302b33450cd184c769c2c4d7a7e26d63384.png)
